assertions.text: Response says the user is asked once whether to retry that batch with CODEX_KIT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS=480000, after the default 240 s limit was used first
Response says a decline or a failed retry leaves the batch unfinished, its Claude findings single-sided (Medium), and the unfinished batch disclosed in inspection_limits
Response says envelopes from batches that already finished are kept, not discarded
Response says the timed-out batch's slices are not completed and are not passed as --completed-slice
